data.long_meaning: Devyavesh is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Yavesh' meaning 'dwelling'. This name signifies a divine being who resides in the universe and oversees its functioning. The name Devyavesh carries the meaning “God dwelling in the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devyavesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god dwelling in the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: The name Devyavesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deva' (meaning God) and 'Yavesh' (meaning invoker or summoner). This name was commonly used during ancient Hindu rituals where gods were invoked and worshipped.

Devyavesh is also mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, including the 'Mahabharata' and the 'Rigveda'. In the 'Mahabharata', Devyavesh is invoked by Arjuna during the Battle of Kurukshetra to seek divine blessings and guidance.
